steps.title: Combine and boil
steps.body: In a saucepan, combine **1 cup uncooked rice**, **1 tsp butter or margarine**, **2 tsp minced garlic**, **1 tsp freshly squeezed lime juice** and **1 × 15 oz can chicken broth**. Bring to a boil.

steps.title: Simmer the rice
steps.body: Cover and cook on low 15–20 minutes, until rice is tender. Remove from heat.

steps.title: Mix the lime and cilantro
steps.body: In a small bowl, combine **1 Tbsp lime juice**, **2 tsp sugar** and **3 Tbsp cilantro**.

steps.title: Fluff the rice
steps.body: Pour over hot cooked rice and mix in as you fluff the rice.
